import asyncio, json
from explore_summary import call_json

async def q(sql):
    res = await call_json("sql", "execute_sql_statement", {"catalog": "[name]", "statement": sql, "wait_timeout": "30s"})
    if res.get("status", {}).get("state") != "SUCCEEDED":
        print("SQL ERROR:", res)
        return []
    cols = [c["name"] for c in res.get("manifest", {}).get("schema", {}).get("columns", [])]
    rows = res.get("result", {}).get("data_array", [])
    return [dict(zip(cols, r)) for r in rows]
